name: finite/infinite element
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 联合有限域与无界域离散方法的数值表示。

complete_examples.text: The VTS system is modelled as an integration of the multi-rigid-body vehicle sub-model, multi-scale finite element ballast less track sub-model and finite/infinite element (FE/IE) soil sub-model, where the IE method is introduced to deal with the boundary condition of the far-field soil.
Besides, the 2.5D finite/infinite element (FE/IE) method [27,30,33] and the 2.5D FE/BE method [34–36] were extensively developed.
